build_llama_model: build an inference-only LLaMA model compatible with HuggingFace weights using LlamaConfig
create_llama_mlp: create a LLaMA MLP block with gate_up_proj, down_proj, and SiLU activation
create_llama_attention: create a LLaMA attention layer with QKV projection, rotary embeddings, and tensor parallel support
create_llama_decoder_layer: create a LLaMA decoder layer with self-attention, MLP, and residual connections
load_llama_weights: load HuggingFace-compatible weights into a LlamaModel with stacked parameter mapping and KV scale remapping
